name: 10 Years of Cubing in Negros 2026

venue.name: SM City Bacolod
venue.address: Rizal Street, Reclamation Area, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, Philippines

information: Get your solves in as **10 Years of Cubing in Negros 2026** is right around the corner! This December marks a decade of speedcubing excellence in the Negros Island Region, and it's time to celebrate how far the community has come. * All the necessary information can be found in the tabs above. * If you are interested in participating, the full registration details can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/10YearsinNegros2026#75403-must-read-payment-and-registration). * Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating. * Please take note that the schedule given is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it. ​ ###### By participating in this event, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition. Furthermore, by your presence, you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used in any format for any purpose worldwide by the organization team and its partners. This includes your likeness and voice to be included therein without compensation, credit, or other consideration. If you do not wish to be photographed, recorded, or appear under these conditions, you should not participate and enter the event premises. ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDk4MTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--00a5870a9a8d556fc7ff2c92c46d6963e9ae4652/image.png)
